1-'In order to speed up progress for piling work at the construction site G0-D1810BX0 RHI request to agree on mass pile driving before testing. Pile Testing in accordance with the requirements of the RD will be performed after mass pile installation as same as design approach with TQS-GPP-RHI-GLE-CIV-00002_01

2-'Drive the pile from the existing elevation of site preparation. The embankment to the design elevations will be done before lean concrete of the pile caps

'Agreed mass pile driving without changing the design and estimate documentation, subject to mandatory control of the bearing capacity of piles through the value of the actual residual failure , in accordance with formulas 7.18 and 7.20 of SP 50-102-2003. With indications
the bearing capacity of the pile is less than the design load on the pile specified in KZh1 to stop the pile driving.

During the verification of drawings, the backfilling quantity and survey scheme is missing on drawings. In order to start work and complete incoming control of material, soil, we request to continue work as stated in sketch. 

'Record on Journal with consideration quantity of material for incoming control.

During the verification of drawings, the backfilling quantity and survey scheme is missing on drawings. In order to start work and complete incoming control of material, soil, we request to continue work as stated in sketch. 

'Record on Journal with consideration quantity of material for incoming control.

After reviewing the detail design documents, it was revealed that the calculation of the reinforcement mass was performed incorrectly. We ask to correct the statements and specifications. See attachment
In order  to ensure the onsite constructability, we request for approval on the concrete joints for the pilecaps of the central control room building, in accordance to the attached scheme.

After reviewing the detail desgn documents, it was revealed that
1. It is necessary to include in the notes the requirements for the overlap length, since the maximum length of the supplied fittings does not exceed 11700 mm. It is also required to recalculate the volume of reinforcement taking into account overlap.

After reviewing the detail design documents, it was revealed that
1. The number of column fittings Км1, Км2, Км3, Км4, Км5, Км6, Км7, Км8 in the steel consumption sheet does not correspond to the specification
2. The number of monolithic wall fittings См1, См2, См3, См4, См5, См6, См7, См8, См9, См10, См11, См12, См13, См14, См15, См16, См17, См18, См19, См20, См21, См22, См23, См24, См25, См26, См27, См28, См29, См30, См31, См32, См33, См34, См35, См36 in the steel consumption sheet does not meet the specification
3. The dimensions in the wall opening См20 are not specified
4. According to sheet 8 section Л-Л, the positions of the fittings are not indicated.
5. Layout of reinforcement bars of monolithic overlap sheet 56 "Layout of the lower row of reinforcement bars of monolithic overlap" on the axis В, Г in axes 1-6" In axes 4-5, the position of the reinforcement is not specified
6. In the specification according to sheet 10, the number of fittings is incorrectly calculated, 8064 pieces are correct
7. Will there be transverse reinforcement on the sections of sheet 56 "Layout of the lower row of reinforcement bars of monolithic overlap" in the axes В,Г - 6-7, 8-9, 10-11; in the axes Б,Д,Е- 11-12; in the axes Б,Д,Е- 5-6; Since there are unspecified fittings in the drawings.
8. Please specify the number of fittings pos.68, pos.80 sheet 56 "Layout of the lower row of reinforcement bars of monolithic overlap", since the number in the drawings does not correspond to the specification.
9. Please clarify the position of the reinforcement sheet 56 "Layout of the lower row of reinforcement bars of monolithic overlap" in axes В,Г-(4-5), since there is no information on the name of the position of the reinforcement on the section.
10. Please specify the number of fittings pos. 37, 74, 103, 105, 76, 102, 120, 187, 192, 209, 200, 203
11. On sheet 6 "Reinforcement schemes of coating plates" there are references to the section 3-3, 4-4, but there are no sections themselves.
12. Please specify the number of fittings ∅10-A500S m.p. and add a section of the lower reinforcement of the coating plates on the axis 6 and specify the length of the reinforcement ∅10-A500S m.p of the lower and upper reinforcement in axes 1-6, 6-13
13.  Please indicate the dimensions for the mounting rod in section 1-1 on sheet 6 "Scheme of reinforcement of coating plates"

After reviewing the detail design documents, it was revealed that
1. The weight of the armature does not correspond to the calculation for Рм7, Рм8
2. The mass in the summary sheet of materials does not correspond to the masses in the specifications and sheets of metal consumption of the grillage.

1-'In order to speed up progress for piling work at the construction site G0-D4910RXO, G1-B4181EPO, G1-B4301FXO, G2-B1110BXO, G2-B1480EPO, G2-C1910RXO, G1-B2210BXO, G1-B5180EPO, G1-B6101FXO, G0-D1801FXO, G1-B2380EPO, G1-B3710RXO, G1-B4910RXO, G1-B4201FXO RHI request to agree on mass pile driving before testing. Pile Testing in accordance with the requirements of the RD will be performed after mass pile installation as same as design approach with TQS-GPP-RHI-GLE-CIV-00002_01

2-'Drive the pile from the existing elevation of site preparation. The embankment to the design elevations will be done before lean concrete of the pile caps

After reviewing the detail design were identified:
1) The dimensions of the grout for the pile cap PM8 are not indicated (sheet 3). If necessary, recalculate volume of the grout
2) The specification for the KP1 frame (sheet 5) incorrectly indicates the weight for item 295. Should be 2.88kg instead of 2.8kg. Recalculate the total mass of the frame

In order to ensure the onsite constructability, we request for 
approval on the concrete joints for the shear wall of the Main Substation and IRR Building, in accordance to the attached scheme.

When reviewing the approved working documentation, it was revealed that in the projects GLE-(G0-D1801FX0)-CI-KJ02-001_02_AL_AS01, GLE-(G1-C1801FX0)-CI-KJ02-001_02_AL, GLE-(G2-C1801FX0)-CI-KJ02- 001_02_AL, there are discrepancies in the marks of monolithic structures, in the layout diagram of foundations FOM1, bottom at elevation. +26.700, on sheets 4, 6, 6 in section 1-1 bottom at elevation. +25,700

G0-D1810BX0 CCR Building was designed as blast proof building. Due to this reason the doors must be also blast proof at the blast area. There are openings at the civil drawings for the doors but there is no any embedded item. Could you please clarify which doors will be blast proof and how the blast proof doors will be fixed to the reinforcement concrete wall?

There are openings at the CCR reinforcement walls. There is no any diagonal rebars around the these openings. Due to this reason we have observed cracks near the openings. We kindly ask to add additional diagonal rebars at the corners of these openings. We recommend to use 2X2 pieces ø16 mm rebars-minimum 1 meter length- for each corner. We kindly ask to use these additional rebars  for all reinforcement concrete walls openings to avoid the cracks.

After reviewing the detailed design, errors were identified which been indicated below:
1) For walls, the weight of steel in the steel consumption sheet is incorrectly indicated
2) The volume of concrete on the floor slabs was incorrectly calculated.
3) The amount of reinforcement for pos. is incorrectly indicated. 103, 192
4) The amount of concrete for the monolithic parapet is incorrectly indicated, the sheet of steel consumption is compiled incorrectly
All calculations can be found in the attachment.

In the new version of the GLE-(G0-D1810BX0)-CIK 03-001_03_AL project, an additional opening in the monolithic wall CM2 has been added in axes 1-2/A. However, the work was performed according to the previous revision of RD GLE-(G0-D1810BX0)-CIK 03-001_02_AL, in which this opening is missing. Please provide a technical solution.

There is mineral wool between gypsum boards at Тип1 partition walls. Properties for this mineral wool is not mentioned at the GLE-(G0-D1810BX0)-AR-AR01-001_03_AL number architectural drawing. RHI kindly asks GSP to give the properties (thickness, volume...) for the mineral wools between gypsum board partition walls.

There are two different definitions for the facade system at CCR architectural drawings. Facade system was defined as metal facade cassettes at sections and details but it is also defined as aluminum composite panel at sheet number 11. We kindly ask GSP to clarify the facade system for the CCR building and define the thickness of the panels.

We ask for projects GLE-(G0-D1810BX0)-AR-AR01-001_02_AL; GLE-(G0-D4810BX0)-AR-AR01-001_02_AL; GLE-(G1-C1810BX0)-AR-AR01-001_02_AL to coordinate the replacement of bricks with KR-r-by 250x120x65/1NF/200/2.0/50 on KR-r-250x120x65/1NF/200/2,0/75 . The necessary documentation is in the application

There is 100 mm thick 90 kg/m3 density mineral wools at air intake chamber rooms. These mineral wools will be install between gypsum boards profiles. RHI kindly suggests to install two pieces 50 mm (90 kg/m3) thick mineral wools instead of one pieces 100 mm (90 kg/m3) due to constructability issues.

There is cement-sand screed for the slope at the top of CCR (G0-D1810) building. This screed thickness was various between 30 mm to 430 mm. RHI would like to pour the screed according to attached (Screed pouring layout) document to avoid the cracks and for the constructability. RHI kindly asks GSP to check and confirm the attached layout for the pouring of screed.

GSP has been submitted attached marked layout to the RHI for pouring the slab on grade. The internal walls on the axis Г was on the same line with permitted area at G0-D1810 building. RHI kindly asks GSP to increase the permitted line 100 cm for the constructability of the walls at the axis G/6-13

There are two different definitions for the facade system at CCR architectural drawings. Facade system was defined as metal facade cassettes at sections and details but it is also defined as aluminum composite panel at sheet number 11. We kindly ask GSP to clarify the facade system for the CCR building and define the thickness of the panels.
Due to absence of facing solutions in DD for internal brick-wall door openings, we kindly ask you to approve the proposal in attachment below for all internal brick wall opening facings.

- For the titles G0-D1810BX0 and G0-D4810BX0, the materials (linear panels RAL 7004) have already been manufactured and a refusal at this

- the minimum production lot of siding with a coating color RAL 7004 is 1500 m2, which is several times higher than the project's needs and subject

During the review of the Detailed Design Documents of HVAC discipline, we have observed, that the diffusers diffusers are connected to main 
channels via rigid ducts with flange joints. Due to varying ceiling levels, the connection ducts differ in length, resulting in time-consuming 
manufacturing and complex installation. 
To optimize the process we propose following solution:
-Replace rigid ducts with corrugated flexible ducts, connected to diffusers and main channels via galvanized transition boxes.
Justification for Flexible Ducts:
-On-Site adjustability: Flexible duct length can be tailored during installation, accommodating ceiling height variations.
-Collision avoidance: Duct routing can be modified flexibly if clashes with other networks (e.g., electrical) occur.
Therefore, we ask Engineering Partner to consider our proposal and make neccesary revisions in Detailed Design Documents

During the review of the Detailed Design Documents of HVAC discipline, we have observed, that the diffusers diffusers are connected to main channels via rigid ducts with flange joints. Due to varying ceiling levels, the connection ducts differ in length, resulting in time-consuming manufacturing and complex installation. 

To optimize the process we propose following solution:
-Replace rigid ducts with corrugated flexible ducts, connected to diffusers and main channels via galvanized transition boxes.

Justification for Flexible Ducts:
-On-Site adjustability: Flexible duct length can be tailored during installation, accommodating ceiling height variations.
-Collision avoidance: Duct routing can be modified flexibly if clashes with other networks (e.g., electrical) occur.

Therefore, we ask Engineering Partner to consider our proposal and make neccesary revisions in Detailed Design Documents.

Based on the Engineering Partner's response TQS-GPP-RHI-GSP-HV-03009_R00, a technical query in revision R01 is being submitted:
In accordance with SP 73.13330.2016 "Internal Plumbing Systems of Buildings," steel pipes with a nominal diameter of up to and including 25 mm should be connected by lap welding (with expansion at one end of the pipe or a threadless coupling).
According to welded joint strength calculations (calculations taken from SP 16.13330.2017), the strength characteristics of full-penetration butt joints are higher than those of lap joints.
Furthermore, the Detailed Desing Documents and specifications do not provide for couplings. Therefore, welding work on pipes with a nominal diameter of up to and including 25 mm was performed using butt joints in accordance with the current approved technical code. (See attachment No. 1OTK 532RHI-WPS-UP001 and No. 2.OTK 532RHI-WPS-UP001R2)
Considering the above and the tight deadline for the project, we request approval for the use of butt-welded joints on steel pipes with a nominal diameter of up to 25 mm. 
(Discussed with S.A. Prilutsky on October 30, 2025)

thick), which provides a compressive strength of 0.250 MPa at 10% relative deformation.
